text:
The median asking rent in Gelsenkirchen stands at 7.56 €/m², up 3.4 % year‑on‑year and 23.5 % over the past five years. The 25th‑percentile is 6.77 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 8.45 €/m², placing the city 36th of the 37 most expensive German markets.

Market tightness is moderate: properties stay on the market for 41 days and only 16 % are let within a week, while the vacancy rate is 3.4 %. Rent burden for a two‑person household averages 13.5 % of income, and asking rents are about 38 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 5.47 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 8.02 €/m² in the next 12 months, with a range of 7.78 – 8.17 €/m², reflecting a 6.1 % increase.
